en.title: Maximum Cars Built on Two Assembly Lines
en.description:
Each car can be assigned to either assembly line, cannot switch lines once started, and is built at most once. The two lines have time budgets X and Y respectively; maximize the number of cars built.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, examples, solution, and tests.
en.input: The first line contains N X Y (1≤N≤1000, 1≤X,Y≤500), and the second line contains N durations (1..1000).
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation:
Example 1: each line builds one car of duration 1, for 2 in total.

Example 2: split the cars as 3+5 and 4+5, for 4 cars in total.

Example 3: any two cars take at least 9, so each line builds at most one car, for 2 in total.
hints: Try adding cars as prefixes in ascending order of duration, and use a bitset to maintain the reachable total durations of the cars assigned to the first line. The prefix can be built if some total s≤X also has sum−s≤Y.
